description: This file defines a PHP trait named ClaimServiceTrait which provides a method to retrieve a ClaimService instance from a service container. It is part of the Claim module in the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Traits/Service directory, indicating its role in providing reusable service-related functionality for claim handling.

methods.name: getClaimService
methods.description: Returns an instance of ClaimService by retrieving it from the service container.
